description: External modules Diffseal cannot read offline: a change to their source or version, or their removal, is reviewed and never passed.

cases.name: a registry module version bump is reviewed, naming the module, both versions and every root (source case: terraform-aws-eks-blueprints ce2d1e58f, EKS module 19 to 20 in 35 roots)
a git module ref bump is reviewed, naming the old and new source (source case: terraform-aws-rds-aurora 959228c5f, VPC module to v5)
adding a version to an unversioned registry module is reviewed
removing an external module call is reviewed: its resources are destroyed and cannot be listed offline
changing only the inputs of an external module keeps today's gate (an unknown update)
review 6: passing null to an external module input is a change of its inputs, not provider null semantics
review 7: changing count of an external module is reviewed: its instances may be destroyed
